Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

Core persistence, recipe families, diagnostics, and FS2 progress/cancellation are implemented, but plugin interfaces and the full app-facing visualization/uncertainty boundary have not been shown complete as one contract.

Evidence:
- plan/src/main/scala/eyes4s/plan/Preflight.scala:28 RecipeFamily
- fs2/src/main/scala/eyes4s/fs2/Execution.scala:40 progress/outcome model
- codec/src/test/scala/eyes4s/codec/SchemaCompatibilitySuite.scala:64 pinned codecs

Remaining / next action: Complete and independently test plugin seams, canonical app payloads, migrations, cancellation, and cross-platform fixtures against the complete stated schema.

Disposition: Keep open.
